newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Mental unit gets services deal.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Mental unit gets services deal.

text.p: Horizon Mental Health Management Inc said Wednesday that its subsidiary, Florida Professional Psychological Services Inc, has signed an agreement with Well Care HMO Inc to provide behavioral health care services to Florida Medicaid and commercially insured members.

The agreement will initially cover about 62,000 Florida Medicaid and commercial members and calls for Florida PPS to provide inpatient and outpatient mental health services through its existing mental health provider network.
